page_title: CRY 1-1 CHE | Crystal Palace v Chelsea 04/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Tim Robinson is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+3' Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the middle of the net, but Robert Sanchez makes a decent save to stop the effort.
90+2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
90+1' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) trips an opposition player and Tim Robinson signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Chelsea.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes the corner but it's cleared.
87' Oliver Glasner has decided to substitute Eberechi Eze and he is replaced by Eddie Nketiah (Crystal Palace).
86' Substitution. Jadon Sancho leaves the pitch and is replaced by Noni Madueke (Chelsea).
85' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
82' 1 - 1 Goal! Eberechi Eze passes the ball to the feet of Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:1.
81' Substitution. Nicolas Jackson makes his way off the pitch and Marc Guiu (Chelsea) comes on as his replacement.
80' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) attempts to discuss the decision with Tim Robinson, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
77' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 11:13.
74' The corner kick from Cole Palmer (Chelsea) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
73' Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
73' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) is about to take a corner kick.
73' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
71' Good chance! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
71' Cole Palmer has a look up and finds Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) in space. He wastes no time in trying to test the keeper from distance but the shot is just wide of the left post.
70' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

69' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. The referee points to the corner flag and Crystal Palace will take a corner.
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daichi Kamada (Crystal Palace) comes onto the pitch so that Cheick Doucoure can be given a rest.
65' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Levi Colwill (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
62' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Pedro Neto.
61' Jefferson Lerma (Crystal Palace) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Tim Robinson blows his whistle and it's Malo Gusto (Chelsea) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
59' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
56' Crystal Palace fail to score from a corner as Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) leaps to collect the ball.

55' Chris Richards (Crystal Palace) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up in the roof of the net, but Robert Sanchez pulls off a decent save to thwart him.
55' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) commits a rough foul. Tim Robinson stops the game and makes a call. Crystal Palace are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
54' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
54' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) works the corner short.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace). The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Crystal Palace.
52' Cheick Doucoure (Crystal Palace) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tim Robinson has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
49' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
46' A pass from Daniel Munoz (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by Robert Sanchez and the move breaks down.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.

43' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Crystal Palace will have a goal kick.
41' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
41' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul. Crystal Palace have a free kick from a promising distance.

38' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
37' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) blows a big chance to score after blasting the ball under the crossbar, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
36' The corner from Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) is intercepted by Robert Sanchez.
36' Tyrick Mitchell (Crystal Palace) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
35' Crystal Palace failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
34' What a huge chance for Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
32' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) launches a cross from the corner, but Dean Henderson is alert to thwart the effort.
32' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Chelsea.
29' Josh Acheampong (Chelsea) outbattles the defender to win the ball from the corner, but he can't quite control his header and sends it just wide of the left post.
28' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
28' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Chelsea have a corner.
26' Chance! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
26' The ball is cleared after Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
20' What an opportunity! Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) wins the ball from the resulting set piece and unleashes a precise shot from inside the goal area which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
17' Chelsea are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
14' 0 - 1 Goal! Jadon Sancho displays great vision and sends a pass to Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. The score is 0:1.
10' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) was too forceful with his tackle and Tim Robinson interrupted the game to signal a free kick.

10' The game is interrupted. Maxence Lacroix (Crystal Palace) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Chelsea.

9' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
7' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
6' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
5' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
3' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
1' Ismaila Sarr (Crystal Palace) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Tim Robinson will supervise the game today.
